messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R Group Survey
messages.body_plain:
I was disappointed that nobody showed up for the last R group session.  We have another one this Friday, I will again be at Stone building 3301, as well as online in my personal Zoom room, https://fsu.zoom.us/my/ralmond.

I've also put together a little survey to assess how many people are actively interested as well as get some ideas about topics and possible alternate times.

Here is the link:  https://fsu.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_8cEPa4caCY5mtSK

It is not anonymous, but the questions aren't that embarrassing.

    --Russell
